title: Paow · vila (kort text): nickar
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: hon sitter still, och filmen börjar och slutar på ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. About one second in she looks into the camera and gives one small, quick nod of greeting, as to a player who has just sat down: her chin dips a little and comes straight back up, her eyes stay open and her lips closed in her soft smile. From the third second she is in the first pose and holds still to the end.
